title: Which bank will the U.S. Treasury sanction over alleged financial ties to Iran during August 31–September 6, 2026?
background: The United States uses financial sanctions to restrict institutions accused of helping Iran access the international financial system.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official U.S. Treasury sanctions announcements and Office of Foreign Assets Control designation records. 
  Resolution Conditions : Identify the bank newly sanctioned during August 31–September 6, 2026, for allegedly facilitating financial transactions for Iran. Resolve when the Treasury publicly announces the designation. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The bank's commonly used name.
